title: Distill Locally, Schedule Globally: Flow Maps for Few-Step Text-to-Speech
abstract: arXiv:2609.36324v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow-matching text-to-speech (TTS) models achieve high synthesis quality but require many neural function evaluations (NFEs) to integrate their generative trajectories. Recent few-step flow-map distillation approaches for TTS construct targets from numerically integrated teacher trajectories, creating a trade-off between target accuracy and training cost. We propose Local Flow-Map Distillation (LFMD), which adapts Eulerian Map Distillation to conditional TTS and avoids teacher trajectory integration during target construction. For inference, we derive a sampling schedule (TD-DP) from teacher dynamics and consistency of the learned maps, with a single cost graph supporting multiple NFE budgets without external audio-metric evaluation. Because scheduling offers no flexibility at one NFE, we refine this regime with alignment-aware temporal self-distillation using soft-DTW. translated_title: 局部蒸馏，全局调度：面向少步文本转语音的流映射
translated_abstract: 流匹配文本转语音（TTS）模型能够实现较高的合成质量，但需要大量的神经函数评估（NFE）来对其生成轨迹进行积分求解。近期面向TTS的少步流映射蒸馏方法需要从数值积分得到的教师轨迹来构建训练目标，这在目标精度与训练成本之间产生了权衡。我们提出局部流映射蒸馏（LFMD），该方法将欧拉映射蒸馏适配到条件TTS任务中，并在构建训练目标时避免了教师轨迹的数值积分。在推理阶段，我们从教师模型动力学和学习映射的一致性出发，推导出一种采样调度方法（TD-DP），仅用单一成本图即可支持多种NFE预算，且无需外部音频指标评估。由于在单次NFE下调度不具备灵活性，我们进一步使用基于soft-DTW的对齐感知时间自蒸馏来改进这一机制。在Seed-TTS和LibriSpeech-PC数据集上，LFMD提升了低NFE合成（质量）……
tldr: 提出局部流映射蒸馏（LFMD）方法，通过避免教师轨迹积分并结合全局采样调度TD-DP与soft-DTW时间自蒸馏，显著提升少步流匹配文本转语音模型在低NFE预算下的合成质量。
en_tdlr: Proposes Local Flow-Map Distillation (LFMD), which avoids costly teacher trajectory integration and combines a globally derived sampling schedule (TD-DP) with soft-DTW temporal self-distillation to improve low-NFE synthesis quality for few-step flow-matching text-to-speech.
